title: Employment Support and Income Assistance Act
verified_how: the statutes register itself could NOT be reached (nslegislature.ca refused the connection - see access_notes), so in-force status is unverified and is recorded as unclear. The title and citation were verified instead on the Government of Nova Scotia's Office of the Registrar of Regulations site on 2026-09-23: fetched https://novascotia.ca/just/regulations/regs/esiaregs.htm, which states it is made under Section 21 of the Employment Support and Income Assistance Act and gives the enabling Act's citation as 'S.N.S. 2000, c. 27'; the Act also appears as a live heading in the official 'Regulations by Act' index at https://novascotia.ca/just/regulations/regsbyact.htm, which lists Acts with regulations currently in force
notes: Provincial social assistance: income assistance, employment support and special-needs allowances.
